answer: For your booking, a security deposit of PKR 25,000 is required for direct bookings. It will be refunded within 3 business days after your check-out inspection.
guest_message: Do I need to pay a security deposit?
evidence:
[{"source_id":"2.4","title":"Security deposit (direct bookings only)","text":"House manual > 2. Booking Rules, Fees and Policies > 2.4 Security deposit (direct bookings only)

For **direct bookings** (booked with us and not through a platform) we collect a refundable security deposit of **PKR 25,000**. Pay it by bank transfer or mobile wallet (Easypaisa or JazzCash) at least 24 hours before arrival. The host sends the payment details. After you check out and we inspect the apartment, the deposit is refunded to the same account within **3 business days**, minus the cost of any damage or fees described in section 11.7.

For bookings made through **Airbnb or Booking.com** we do not collect a deposit. The platform's own damage-protection rules apply instead."},{"source_id":"14.4","title":"Security deposit refund","text":"House manual > 14. Checking Out > 14.4 Security deposit refund

For direct bookings, the deposit is refunded within **3 business days** after check-out inspection (section 2.4)."},{"source_id":"11.7","title":"Damage and loss","text":"House manual > 11. House Rules > 11.7 Damage and loss

Please report breakages straight away. Accidental breakage of small items (a glass or plate) is not a problem if you tell us. Larger damage or missing items are charged at replacement cost; for direct bookings this is deducted from the security deposit, and for platform bookings we claim through the platform.
